value_correctness.summary: SAR thousand. Transcribed sets: FY2022 (IFRS 4 original), FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, Q1/H1/9M 2025, Q1 2026, H1 2026. Findings: (1) IFRS 17 transition (FY2023 note 4) restated 2022: total assets 1,372,115 -> 1,020,120, equity 336,450 -> 354,015, net loss -28,315 -> -41,378, EPS -0.57 -> -0.83, cash 342,270 (includes murabaha) -> 336,530; 1 Jan 2022 equity 393,718. (2) FY2023 cash flow comparative re-presented in the FY2024 annual (operating -110,312 -> -108,911, investing -115,466 -> -116,866). (3) FY2023 cash flow prints net change -225,959 though components add to -225,960; FY2025 prints 21,229 vs 21,230; H1 2025 20,739 vs 20,738 (rounding as printed, declared). (4) Other income is large and swings the result: FY2025 other income 37,158 on profit before zakat 29,801 (insurance service result -13,061); Q1 2025 other income 19,345 of 10,881; Q1 2026 has none. (5) 9M 2025 Q3 profit 631 after a service loss of 30,622 offset by a 24,789 investment-property fair value gain. Net income after zakat: FY2025 21,701; FY2024 26,889; FY2023 38,188; FY2022 -41,378 (IFRS 17) / -28,315 (IFRS 4); H1 2026 7,470 (Q1 5,478, Q2 1,992) vs H1 2025 16,557. Seasonality: H1 2025 insurance revenue 706,079 vs 9M 1,072,159 vs FY 1,445,363, so Q3 and Q4 are not run-rate quarters of H1.
